text: それは　それは　にぎやかな　まちだそうです　オレも　いって　みたいなあ…

structure.jp: それは　それは　にぎやかな　まちだそうです
structure.en: I hear it's a really, really lively town

structure.jp: オレも　いって　みたいなあ…
structure.en: I'd like to go there too...

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そうだ after a finished statement says you heard it from someone else. まちだそうです = 'I hear it's a town'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means doing it to see what it is like. いって みたい = 'I'd like to go and see'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. いって みたい = 'I want to try going'.
